exportParticipantsModal.title: Export list of participants?
exportParticipantsModal.description: Choose a date to export the participant list for the entire day, broken down by session.
exportParticipantsModal.applyFilterLabel: Apply calendar view filters (Activity name, Establishment, Teacher, Session level)
exportParticipantsModal.applyFilterDescription: If unselected, the list will be exported without filters.
exportParticipantsModal.errorMessage: An error occurred while exporting the participant list. Please try again.

backgroundTask.genericError: An error has occurred. Check your connection and try refreshing the page.

cancelModal.title: Cancel session?
cancelModal.description: You can restore this session at any time but you won’t be able to retrieve any bookings related to this session.
cancelModal.bookingsAlert_one: {{number}} member who booked this session will have their credits refunded.
cancelModal.bookingsAlert_other: {{number}} members who booked this session will have their credits refunded.
cancelModal.groupSessionAlert: This session is part of the group {{groupName}}.
cancelModal.notificationLabel: Send a notification to all members who booked this session
cancelModal.cancelLinkedSessions: Cancel linked sessions (both online and on-site)
cancelModal.descriptionFutureSessions: Select which sessions will be cancelled
cancelModal.errorMessage: An error occurred while cancelling the session. Please try again later.

cancelMultipleSessionsModal.title: Cancel multiple sessions?
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.description: You can restore these sessions at any time, but you won’t be able to retrieve any bookings related to them. If you applied filters before cancelling, those filters will be kept for the selected period.
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.cancelAlert_one: {{sessionsNumber}} sessions scheduled on {{startDate}} will be cancelled. Members who booked them will receive a credit refund.
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.cancelAlert_other: {{sessionsNumber}} sessions scheduled between {{startDate}} and {{endDate}} will be cancelled. Members who booked them will receive a credit refund.
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.groupSessionAlert: Just a heads up: the following sessions in this period cannot be canceled. To remove them, delete the associated 'Grouped session' first. All other sessions will still be canceled.
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.confirmTickDescription: I understand that cancelling multiple sessions will remove these bookings from my calendar and automatically refund credits to members.
cancelMultipleSessionsModal.errorMessage: An error occurred while cancelling the sessions. Please try again later.

deleteModal.title: Permanently delete session?
deleteModal.description: Deleting this session will remove any booking records. If there were bookings and members weren’t refunded when it was canceled, their credits will also be lost.
deleteModal.commonAlert: Just a heads up: this action is permanent and cannot be undone.
deleteModal.groupSessionAlert: This session is part of the group {{groupName}}.
deleteModal.descriptionFutureSessions: Select which sessions will be deleted
deleteModal.errorMessage: An error occurred while deleting the session. Please try again later.

restoreModal.title: Restore session?
restoreModal.description: Restoring this session will make it visible again to members. You can cancel it again at any time.
restoreModal.errorMessage: An error occurred while restoring the session. Please try again later.
